from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class BMP280_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    REG_WIDTH = 16  # 本基准目标器件寄存器宽度（16 位为主）

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.regs = {
            0xD0: 0x58,  # id
            0xE0: 0x00,  # reset
            0xF3: 0x00,  # status
            0xF4: 0x00,  # ctrl_meas
            0xF5: 0x00,  # config
            0xF7: 0x80,  # press_msb
            0xF8: 0x00,  # press_lsb
            0xF9: 0x00,  # press_xlsb
            0xFA: 0x80,  # temp_msb
            0xFB: 0x00,  # temp_lsb
            0xFC: 0x00   # temp_xlsb
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if nbytes == 1:
            return (self.regs[addr] & 0xFF00) >> 8
        else:
            return self.regs[addr]

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr == 0xE0 and data == 0xB6:  # soft reset
            self.regs = {
                0xD0: 0x58,  # id
                0xE0: 0x00,  # reset
                0xF3: 0x00,  # status
                0xF4: 0x00,  # ctrl_meas

                0xF7: 0x80,  # press_msb

                0xF9: 0x00,  # press_xlsb
                0xFA: 0x80,  # temp_msb
                0xFB: 0x00,  # temp_lsb
                0xFC: 0x00   # temp_xlsb
            }
        elif nbytes == 1:
            self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & 0x00FF) | ((data & 0xFF) << 8)
        else:
            self.regs[addr] = data
